How DAM Verifies Evidence

India Regulatory & Scam Detection Protocol v2.4

1. Primary Source Registry First

DAM indexes official Indian registries including the Reserve Bank of India (rbi.org.in), Press Information Bureau Fact Check (pib.gov.in), Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (trai.gov.in), and CERT-In (cert-in.org.in). It never accepts second-hand rumors without primary confirmation.

2. Autonomous Challenger Agent

Every finding is challenged by a dedicated red-team agent that actively seeks reasons why the verdict could be premature, outdated, or jurisdictionally restricted (e.g. state-specific disconnections vs central notifications).

3. Three Separate Verdicts — Never Blended

DAM rejects single composite truth scores. We report:
• Factual Correctness (Supported, Contradicted, Mixed, Unverified)
• Scam Risk (Low, Medium, High + specific triggered signals)
• Evidence Sufficiency (Sufficient, Partial, Insufficient)

4. Insufficient Evidence is a First-Class Verdict

When authoritative proof is not yet published by the relevant regulatory authority, DAM explicitly concludes "Insufficient Evidence" instead of guessing or hallucinating.
